start: 🔒 Verification & Access Control This service protects communities with a quick verification step before approving join requests. When you request access to a protected group, your verification challenge will appear here.
challenge_body:
Hello, {name}. You requested access to {chat_title}. Solve this operation to complete verification:
What is {a} + {b}?
⏳ Time: {timeout} seconds 🎯 Attempts available: {attempts}
success: ✅ Access approved Verification succeeded and your request for {chat_title} was approved.
wrong_retry: ⚠️ Incorrect answer You still have another chance. 🎯 Attempts remaining: {attempts}
wrong: ❌ Verification failed The selected answer was incorrect. Your join request has been declined.
timeout: ⏳ Time expired No answer was received within {timeout} seconds. Your join request was canceled.
session_expired: ⚠️ This verification session has expired or has already been processed.
generic_error: ⚠️ Verification could not be completed. Please request access again.
rate_limited: 🛑 Too many requests in a short period. Please try again later.
